description: TikTok Shop product reviews — star rating, text, SKU variant, verified purchase, country, and review photos. Costs ~45 credits (2.25/result). Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh. Envelope includes cached + cachedAt on hits.

limit.description: Max items to return (default 20, max 200). Billed per result.

url.description: TikTok Shop product URL, e.g. https://www.tiktok.com/shop/pdp/1731962298839634826. The URL platform must match this endpoint's platform. Do not pass cross-platform URLs, e.g. YouTube to TikTok, Instagram to Facebook, LinkedIn to X/Twitter, or Pinterest to Rumble.

name: tiktok_shop_product_reviews
title: TikTok Shop Product Reviews
